publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, via FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
title_or_table: All employees, thousands, seasonally adjusted, total nonfarm and 17 sectors
table_id: PAYEMS, USPRIV, USMINE, USCONS, MANEMP, USWTRADE, USTRADE, CES4300000001, CES4422000001, USINFO, USFIRE, USPBS, CES6561000001, CES6562000001, USLAH, USSERV, USGOVT, CES9091000001
vintage: as posted on FRED on November 6, 2026; the latest two months are preliminary and BLS revises them
qualification: Seasonally adjusted. The Bureau of Labor Statistics revises each month’s first estimate in the next two monthly reports, so August and September 2026 are preliminary, and a yearly benchmark revision can move earlier months. FRED copies the Bureau of Labor Statistics series; bls.gov refuses automated requests, so the studio read FRED (DR-60).
unit: Thousands of jobs; percent change since January 2022

sector.description: industry sector as BLS names it

pct_change_since_2022_01.description: percent change from the sector’s January 2022 level

change_since_2022_01_thousands.description: change from the sector’s January 2022 level

status.description: preliminary for August and September 2026, else final

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics, all employees by industry, seasonally adjusted, January 2022 to September 2026, United States, via FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. Retrieved November 6, 2026. August and September 2026 are preliminary and will be revised.
derivation: Rows from January 2022 on; pct_change_since_2022_01 and change_since_2022_01_thousands compare each month with the same series in January 2022 (D2-126: both jobs charts draw January 2022 to September 2026, one window).
